what.text: This page follows refugees from Turkmenistan in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1864 Turkmen refugees, and Germany hosted 47.0% of them.
After Germany, the largest hosts are the United States, Russia and Poland.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Turkmenistan, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1996 to 1997 and 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1994 at 7 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 3179, at the end of 1997.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
